ethics_check.title: Ethics Approval Check
ethics_check.summary_text: All papers that appeared to involve live data collection contained an ethics approval statement.

table.text: This study was conducted in accordance with the principles of the Declaration of Helsinki and approved by [redacted for peer review].

We recruited adult patients with glioma, brain metastases or Symptomatic Intracerebral and (c) in consultation with a multi-disciplinary panel of specialists involved in the care of patients with neurological diseases. [12] For patients, the questionnaire measured the following domains: ACP knowledge (9 items), attitudes (16 items), and perception (16 items), adapted from Zhou et al. [13] Knowledge of ACP items contained nine statements allowing respondents to choose one appropriate answer (True, False, or Don't Know) for each statement (Supplementary Table 1).
table.formatted: We recruited adult patients with glioma, brain metastases or Symptomatic Intracerebral and (c) in consultation with a multi-disciplinary panel of specialists involved in the care of patients with neurological diseases. <ref type="bibr" target="#b11">[12]</ref> For patients, the questionnaire measured the following domains: ACP knowledge (9 items), attitudes (16 items), and perception (16 items), adapted from Zhou et al. <ref type="bibr" target="#b12">[13]</ref> Knowledge of ACP items contained nine statements allowing respondents to choose one appropriate answer (True, False, or Don't Know) for each statement (Supplementary Table <ref type="table">1</ref>).

table.text: The inclusion criteria were: (a) patients with a histological diagnosis of glioma or metastatic brain disease; (b) patients aged 21 and above; and (c) patients able to communicate in English or Chinese.

We also recruited caregivers caring for eligible patients using the following inclusion criteria were: (a) caring for patients with the diagnosis of patients inclusion criteria; (b) aged 21 and above; and (c) able to communicate in English or Chinese.
Written informed consent was obtained for all participants.

ethics_check.report:
Based on the following text, we would expect an ethics approval statement, and it was present:

> We recruited adult patients with glioma, brain metastases or Symptomatic Intracerebral and (c) in consultation with a multi-disciplinary panel of specialists involved in the care of patients with neurological diseases. [12] For patients, the questionnaire measured the following domains: ACP knowledge (9 items), attitudes (16 items), and perception (16 items), adapted from Zhou et al. [13] Knowledge of ACP items contained nine statements allowing respondents to choose one appropriate answer (True, False, or Don't Know) for each statement (Supplementary Table 1).

> The inclusion criteria were: (a) patients with a histological diagnosis of glioma or metastatic brain disease; (b) patients aged 21 and above; and (c) patients able to communicate in English or Chinese.

> We also recruited caregivers caring for eligible patients using the following inclusion criteria were: (a) caring for patients with the diagnosis of patients inclusion criteria; (b) aged 21 and above; and (c) able to communicate in English or Chinese.

> Written informed consent was obtained for all participants.

Ethics approval statement:

> This study was conducted in accordance with the principles of the Declaration of Helsinki and approved by [redacted for peer review].

power.title: Power Analysis Check
report:
::: {.callout-tip title="Learn More" collapse="true"}

Power analyses need to contain the following information to be interpretable: the type of power analysis, the statistical test, the software used, sample size, critical alpha criterion, power level, effect size, and an effect size metric. In addition, it is recommended to make sure the power analysis is reproducible (by sharing the code, or a screenshot, of the power analysis), and to provide good arguments for why the study was designed to detect an effect of this size.

For an a-priori power analysis, where the sample size is determined, reporting all information would look like:

> An a priori power analysis for an independent samples t-test, conducted using the pwr.t.test function from pwr (Champely, 2020), indicated that for a Cohen's d = 0.5, an alpha level of 0.05, and a desired power level of 80% required at least 64 participants in each group.

For a sensitivity power analysis, this sentence would look like:

> A sensitivity power analysis for an independent samples t-test, conducted using the pwr.t.test function from pwr (Champely, 2020), indicated that with 64 participants in each group, and an alpha level of 0.05, a desired power level of 80% was reached for an effect size of d = 0.5.

:::
